name: Familial Isolated Retinal Arteriolar Tortuosity

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Familial Isolated Retinal Arteriolar Tortuosity

criteria.description: Presence of pronounced tortuosity of second- and third-order retinal arterioles on fundoscopic examination
Evidence of autosomal dominant inheritance pattern with affected first-degree relatives
No associated systemic vascular or connective tissue disorders
Presence of mild visual disturbances such as transient blurred vision or scotomas
Confirmation of arteriolar tortuosity by fluorescein angiography or optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of pronounced retinal arteriolar tortuosity with familial inheritance and exclusion of systemic vascular diseases
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by family history and imaging; genetic testing is not currently established.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Familial occurrence of retinal vascular tortuosity
searchTerms: family history of twisted retinal vessels

common.symptomName: Normal visual acuity despite vascular changes
searchTerms: normal eyesight despite blood vessel changes
clear vision with retinal vessel abnormalities
new abnormal blood vessels from lack of oxygen
growth of new retinal vessels due to ischemia

imaging: Fundoscopic examination revealing tortuous retinal arterioles
Fluorescein angiography showing arteriolar tortuosity without leakage
Optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) confirming vascular abnormalities
genetic: No specific gene identified; presumed autosomal dominant inheritance pattern
other: Family history consistent with isolated retinal vascular tortuosity
Absence of systemic vascular or connective tissue abnormalities

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of systemic vascular or connective tissue disease
Genetic mutations identified in connective tissue disorder genes
Retinal hemorrhages with venous dilation rather than arteriolar tortuosity

redFlags: Sudden onset of severe visual loss
Signs of retinal artery or vein occlusion
Evidence of systemic vascular or connective tissue disease
references: Orphanet: Familial Isolated Retinal Arteriolar Tortuosity - ORPHA75326
